name: Pontons (Spain)
description: Light blue field with a yellow pale at the centre and a white two-arched bridge of the arms at the centre of each blue part.
history: The flag incorporates the heraldic symbols, transforming the abbot's crozier of the arms (approved 3 October 1989) into a pale; it was approved on 10 October 2013: an oblong flag of 2:3, light blue, with a yellow pale 1/9 of the length at the centre and the two bridges of two arches of the arms, each 1/3 of the height, at the centre of each blue part.

features.role: two bridges of two arches, one on each side of the pale
